# Piktochart

> Piktochart is an AI-powered visual design platform trusted by 14 million users for creating infographics, presentations, reports, and other branded content without design experience.

Piktochart offers a comprehensive suite of free online design tools with drag-and-drop editors, AI-powered generators, and professional templates. The platform supports multiple export formats (PDF, PNG, PowerPoint, Excel) and integrates with popular services like Google Sheets, LinkedIn, and Facebook for seamless content creation and sharing.

## Key Topics

- AI Design Generator
- Data Visualization
- Drag-and-Drop Editor
- Templates
- Infographic Maker
- Presentation Maker
- Graph Maker
- Brand Customization
- No Design Experience Required
- PDF/PNG/PowerPoint Export
- Free Tool
- Online Editor
- Piktochart Pro
- Multi-format Support
- Social Media Graphics

## Core Design Tools

- [Piktochart Visual](https://piktochart.com/visual): Main product platform for creating infographics, reports, and presentations with AI-powered design capabilities
- [AI Design Generator](https://piktochart.com/ai-design-generator): AI-powered suite for instant visual creation across all design types
- [Infographic Maker](https://piktochart.com/infographic-maker): Professional infographic maker with data visualization tools and expert templates
- [Presentation Maker](https://piktochart.com/presentation-maker): Free presentation maker with customizable slides and professional templates
- [Pitch Deck Creator](https://piktochart.com/presentation-maker/pitch-deck): Specialized pitch deck creator with 80+ expert-designed templates for investor presentations

## Data & Visualization Tools

- [Graph Maker](https://piktochart.com/graph-maker): Graph maker with 20+ chart types for professional data visualization
- [Flowchart Maker](https://piktochart.com/graph-maker/flowchart): Free flowchart maker with symbols and templates for process diagrams
- [Diagram Generator](https://piktochart.com/diagram-maker): AI-powered diagram generator for flowcharts and organizational charts
- [Map Maker](https://piktochart.com/map-maker): Free online map and choropleth maker for geographic data visualization
- [Report Maker](https://piktochart.com/report-maker): Report maker for creating branded reports with integrated graphs and charts

## Marketing & Social Media

- [Social Media Graphic Maker](https://piktochart.com/social-media): Social media graphic maker for creating multi-platform content with brand customization
- [Poster Maker](https://piktochart.com/poster-maker): Online poster maker for professional marketing materials and social media campaigns
- [Brochure Maker](https://piktochart.com/brochure-maker): Free brochure maker with professional templates and intuitive drag-and-drop editor

## Personal & Event Design

- [Card Maker](https://piktochart.com/card-maker): Card maker for designing greeting, invitation, and business cards
- [Invitation Maker](https://piktochart.com/invitation-maker): Online invitation maker for custom event invitations with professional templates
- [Resume Maker](https://piktochart.com/resume-maker): ATS-friendly resume maker with editable templates for job applications

## Multimedia & Video

- [Video Editor](https://piktochart.com/video-editor): Free online video editor with auto-captions and automatic transcription features
